# Recurring transaction scheduler

Lets a user register recurring entries (rent, salary, subscriptions) that are
materialised into the ledger on their due date. The scheduler is a pure planning
function over a rule set plus a "now" clock, so it stays deterministic and testable.

## Rule model

- **cadence** — one of `monthly`, `weekly`, `annual`.
- **anchor** — the first due date; later dates are derived from the cadence.
- **template** — the `amount_cents`, `memo`, and category to append when due.

## Due-date resolution

| Cadence  | Next-due rule                          |
| -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| weekly   | anchor + 7·n days                      |
| monthly  | same day-of-month, clamped to month end|
| annual   | same month/day, Feb-29 → Feb-28        |

## Reference

```python
from pocket_ledger.scheduler.recurring import due_between

due = due_between(rules, start="2026-03-01", end="2026-04-01", now=clock.now())
for entry in due:
    store.append(entry)
```

Materialisation is idempotent per `(rule_id, due_date)` so a re-run never
double-posts an entry[^idem].

[^idem]: The scheduler records the last materialised due date per rule; replaying
    the same window is a no-op, which the acceptance test relies on.
